title: Event
description: Core Event entity: a BELIEF about a concrete scheduled occurrence (RFC-014). Mutable; never a Soil fact by itself — the EventOccurrence fact exists only after an explicit mark-occurred review action (never on date passage). Events are individual instantiations: a recurrence series contributes many Events linked via a NATIVE recurring_event_id. No all_day flag: date-only starts_at/ends_at IS the time ambiguity. ends_at is EXCLUSIVE.

source_id.description: NATIVE source id (Event analogue of rfc_message_id). Unique per calendar only — natural key carries calendar_id.

starts_at.description: UTC datetime or bare date (YYYY-MM-DD); date-only = time ambiguity (naturally all-day), no timezone.

ends_at.description: Same union as starts_at. EXCLUSIVE end (RFC 5545 DTEND: a one-day date-only event ends the next day).

occurred_at.description: Null = has not happened / did not happen. Set ONLY by mark-occurred review; providers never set it; date passage never sets it.

status.description: Source truth of the schedule; cancelled events are never stored (removal stamped instead).

participants.description: Plain identifier strings (email preferred); capped at participants_max with metadata.attendee_count preserving the true count.

source.description: Provider provenance — stored flat in entity.data (entities have a single JSON data column; RFC-014 §2.2 storage mapping).

account.description: RFC-012 INV-7 attribution; scope-rule matchable; part of the natural key.

calendar_id.description: Source calendar id; part of the natural key; scope-rule matchable.

etag.description: Source change token; drives upsert no-op detection.

recurring_event_id.description: NATIVE id of the source pattern (never dangles — tada follows_from precedent).

original_start_at.description: Start time this instance had in the series before a move.

captured_after_fact.description: Seeded history: calendar asserted it, we never live-observed it (review triage marker).

scopes.description: Runtime-applied scope labels (entity analogue of fact metadata.scopes; provider-set wins over policy).
